verdict.rationale: Opting out of model training is a fair question for an AI coding service like Devin, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, data-usage policy, or zero-retention setting. Outposts and the CLI sandbox concern where sessions run and how they are isolated, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
